q1.a: Send your recommendation via the "Submit Software" email above, or open an Issue on our GitHub repo. Please include the software name, GitHub link, and a brief description.

q2.q: What if I find incorrect info?
q2.a: Every software detail page has a feedback link at the bottom. You can also email us at the feedback address.

q3.q: Is the software safe to download?
q3.a: All installers come from official GitHub Release pages. We display the original SHA-256 checksums for you to verify. Source code links are provided for full transparency.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We respect and protect every user's privacy

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: OpenSource-Hub ("the Site") takes user privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information. Using the Site means you agree to these terms.

infrastructure.title: Data Storage & Global Transmission
infrastructure.p1: The Site runs on Cloudflare's global edge network, with core data stored in Cloudflare D1 (globally distributed SQLite) and Cloudflare KV (key-value storage).
infrastructure.p2: When you visit, your request is processed by the nearest Cloudflare edge node, which may be outside your country. Cloudflare holds ISO 27001, SOC 2 and other international security certifications.
infrastructure.p3: We only store personal information when you voluntarily submit an email address with a software recommendation or feature request. This data is stored in D1 and transmitted over HTTPS.

ai.title: AI & Automated Processing
ai.p1: The Site uses AI technologies (including DeepSeek LLM and Cloudflare Workers AI translation) to automate:
ai.li1: Open source metadata: automated summarization, classification and translation of GitHub public README files and documentation into user-friendly guides.
ai.li2: Search intent: vector embeddings (Cloudflare Vectorize) convert your search terms into semantic vectors for better matching.
ai.p2: All AI processing targets only public open source metadata (project names, READMEs, star counts). It does NOT involve your personal identity. Your search terms are used only for the current session and are never used for AI model training.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.li1: Browsing data: anonymized access logs for security and traffic analysis.
collection.li2: Search records: stored in anonymous aggregate form to optimize search.
collection.li3: Download behavior: anonymized click data to understand software trends.
collection.li4: User submissions: email and description you provide when recommending software.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.p1: The Site uses cookies and LocalStorage for basic functionality:

necessary.title: Essential Cookies
necessary.li3: Required for the site to function — cannot be disabled

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.li1: Cloudflare Web Analytics (privacy-first) measures page views
analytics.li2: No personal identifiers, no tracking cookies, no fingerprinting
analytics.li3: Google Search Console may be connected in the future for indexing monitoring

cookies.p2: You can reject non-essential cookies via browser settings without affecting core functionality.

usage.title: Usage & Sharing
usage.p1: We use collected information to: provide and improve services, analyze anonymous trends, respond to feedback, and maintain security.
usage.p2: We do NOT sell, trade or transfer your personal information to third parties. Sharing only occurs when legally required or to protect legitimate interests.

opensource.title: Open Source Metadata Sourcing
opensource.p1: All open source software information displayed (name, description, stars, license, author) comes from the GitHub public API. We respect all original authors' intellectual property and open source licenses.
opensource.p2: If you are a project author and believe our display infringes your rights, contact us and we will address it within 7 business days.

retention.title: Data Retention & Deletion
retention.text: We retain personal information only as long as necessary. You may request deletion at any time, and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

about.title: About OpenSource-Hub
about.subtitle: Making quality open source software accessible to everyone

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: Removing barriers to open source software. Great tools shouldn't be hidden behind technical docs and complex installation. Through AI-powered automation, we transform top GitHub projects into consumer-ready applications anyone can understand and use.

trust.title: Transparent & Trustworthy
trust.desc: Every installer comes directly from GitHub's official Release pages. We display original SHA-256 checksums and source code links for you to verify. All content is AI-assisted. We never distribute malware or bundled adware.

s1.title: GitHub Harvesting
s1.desc: Daily automated collection from GitHub Trending and Awesome lists

s2.title: AI Refinement
s2.desc: Large language models transform technical docs into clear multilingual guides

s3.title: Community Driven
s3.desc: Users submit recommendations and corrections to maintain quality together

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: OpenSource-Hub is an open source software aggregation and distribution platform. We do not own copyright to any software; all software belongs to their respective authors or organizations.
disclaimer.p2: We only distribute projects under open licenses (MIT, Apache 2.0, GPL, etc.) and comply with attribution requirements. If you are a copyright holder and believe our display infringes your rights, please contact us.
disclaimer.p3: We are not responsible for data loss, system damage, or other losses from software use. Please review the software's open source license and documentation before downloading.

community.title: Join the Community
community.desc: OpenSource-Hub is a community-driven project. Submit software recommendations, correct AI translations, or contribute code.
